screens.S_ENTRY: Outside the app: launcher icon or shortcut, widget, notification, media button, another app, the system scheduler or adb
screens.S_EXIT: The activity task ended (Back from the library with nothing to undo)
screens.S_LIBRARY: LibraryActivity: tab strip (Artists, Albums, Songs, Playlists, Genres, Files), list of the current tab with a play-all header row, bottom bar with the current song and the overflow menu button
screens.S_LIBRARY_SEARCH: LibraryActivity with the search field of the bottom bar open (keyboard shown)
screens.S_LIBRARY_MENU: Overflow menu (PopupMenu) of the bottom bar: Settings, Playback view, Go home (Files tab), Sort by, Show queue / Hide queue, Dequeue rest, Empty the queue, Save as playlist, Jump to time
screens.S_SLIDE_LIBRARY: LibraryActivity with the sliding panel pulled up: seek bar and the shuffle / previous / play-pause / next / repeat buttons
screens.S_SLIDE_LIBRARY_QUEUE: LibraryActivity with the sliding panel fully up: the queue list (ShowQueueFragment) is visible
screens.S_FANCY_LIBRARY: Bottom sheet context menu (FancyMenu) of a library row
screens.S_DLG_SORT: Sort dialog: single-choice list of sort modes and the "reverse sort" check box
screens.S_DLG_DELETE_MEDIA: Confirm dialog "Delete" for the selected library item (positive button deletes the files)
screens.S_DLG_PLAYLIST: Dialog "Add to playlist": list with "New playlist..." and the existing playlists (PlaylistDialog)
screens.S_DLG_PLAYLIST_INPUT: Dialog "Choose playlist name" (PlaylistInputDialog); variant RENAME renames a playlist (positive button "Rename"), variant CREATE makes a new playlist (positive button "Create")
screens.S_DLG_TRACK_DETAILS: Dialog with the tag details of a song (TrackDetailsDialog)
screens.S_DLG_PLUGINS: Dialog that lists the installed Vanilla Music plugins
screens.S_DLG_JUMP_TO_TIME: Dialog "Jump to time" with hours, minutes and seconds fields (JumpToTimeDialog)
screens.S_PLAYLIST: PlaylistActivity: songs of one playlist with the Edit and Delete buttons
screens.S_PLAYLIST_EDIT: PlaylistActivity in edit mode: drag handles shown, rows can be moved and removed
screens.S_FANCY_PLAYLIST: Bottom sheet context menu (FancyMenu) of a row of the playlist activity
screens.S_FANCY_QUEUE: Bottom sheet context menu (FancyMenu) of a row of the queue list
screens.S_LIBRARY_PAUSED: LibraryActivity is stopped: Home key, another activity or app on top
screens.S_CTX_BUTTON: Context menu of the shuffle button (no shuffle / shuffle songs / shuffle albums) or the repeat button (no repeat / repeat / repeat current song / stop after current song / random)
screens.S_FULL: FullPlaybackActivity: cover, info table (title, artist, album; extra rows after a long press), seek bar and the control buttons, action bar with the playback menu
screens.S_FULL_QUEUE: FullPlaybackActivity with the sliding panel pulled fully up: the queue list is visible
screens.S_FULL_MENU: Action bar overflow menu of FullPlaybackActivity (Delete, Enqueue, More from, Add to playlist, Share, Plugins, Settings, queue entries, Jump to time)
screens.S_MINI: MiniPlaybackActivity: popup dialog with the cover and the control buttons
screens.S_PICKER: AudioPickerActivity: popup dialog with the file name, a progress bar and the buttons Cancel, Enqueue and Play
screens.S_DLG_DELETE_FULL: Confirm dialog "Delete" for the playing song (FullPlaybackActivity)
screens.S_PREFS: PreferencesActivity: list of the settings sections (Audio, Playback, Library, Notifications, Shake, Cover art, Misc, Media library, Playlists, Theme, Help, About)
screens.S_PREFS_AUDIO: Settings > Audio: Equalizer, Replay gain, volume while ducking, gapless playback, headset only, pause on headset unplug, headset launch
screens.S_PREFS_REPLAYGAIN: Settings > Audio > Replay gain: track gain, album gain, bump and untagged de-bump
screens.S_PREFS_PLAYBACK: Settings > Playback: playback on startup, display mode, swipe up / down action, cover press / long-press action
screens.S_PREFS_LIBRARY: Settings > Library: tabs, default action, default playlist action, scroll to song, jump to enqueued song, file browser start folder
screens.S_PREFS_NOTIFICATIONS: Settings > Notifications: notification visibility, notification action
screens.S_PREFS_SHAKE: Settings > Accelerometer shake: enable, action, threshold
screens.S_PREFS_COVERART: Settings > Cover art: cover loaders (Vanilla, shadow, Android, inline) and cover on the lock screen
screens.S_PREFS_MISC: Settings > Misc features: lock screen, keep screen on, idle timeout, double tap on widgets, scrobbling, stock broadcast, readahead
screens.S_PREFS_MEDIALIB: Settings > Media library: scan buttons, statistics, options, media folders (PreferencesMediaLibrary)
screens.S_PREFS_PLAYLIST: Settings > Playlists: auto playlist, synchronization mode, sync folder, relative paths
screens.S_PREFS_THEME: Settings > Theme: list of themes with a colour preview
screens.S_PREFS_ABOUT: Settings > About: web view of about.html
screens.S_TAB_ORDER: TabOrderActivity: draggable, checkable list of the library tabs, with Done and "Restore default" buttons
screens.S_DLG_MEDIALIB_CONFIRM: Confirm dialog "This will delete your cached results..." (shared text for the checkbox change and the Edit button)
screens.S_FOLDERPICKER: FolderPickerActivity (base of MediaFoldersSelectionActivity and FilebrowserStartActivity): a folder tree browser with a path field and a Save/Select button
